items.reason: The PR adds an uncaught throw for a missing encryption key in apps/web/pages/api/auth/two-factor/totp/disable.ts:48-51, producing a framework 500 instead of a JSON error response. The caller unconditionally parses unsuccessful responses as JSON at apps/web/components/settings/DisableTwoFactorModal.tsx:66, so this response causes a parsing failure handled by the generic-error catch at lines 80-82. The UI catches the failure, but the new branch still breaks the expected error-response format.
